title: ATM: Adversarial Tuning Multi-agent System Makes a Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generator

reviews.summary:
This paper introduces a multi-agent system (ATM) that enhances the robustness of the GENERATOR in RAG-QA by involving an ATTACKER and a GENERATOR. It proposes a novel optimization method (MITO). It further evaluates the GENERATOR's resilience
against various noises.
reviews.strengths:
In response to the problem of fabricating content on the Internet, ATM introduces the ATTACKER agent to optimize the GENERATOR agent to better distinguish useful documents.
ATM outperforms on thier benchmark in most cases.
This paper is well-organized and clearly written, which is easy to follow.
reviews.weaknesses:
In the experiment,the authors construct some fabricated documents for each query, but in real-world scenarios, there aren't as many fabricated documents. To explore the potential of ATM for better distinguishing useful documents, I believe it is necessary to test the GENERATOR on other tasks. 
The paper mentions the related work RAAT (Fang et al., 2024), but there is no comparison. RAAT seems to have made their code public, and I think it would be better to supplement the experiments with RAAT.
reviews.questions:
RetRobust13B performs better on Natural Questions when Llama3-70B acts as the ATTACKER. RetRobust13B also achieves comparable performance under some test setups when attacked by Mixtral-8 x 22B and Llama3-70B which are larger models.
Could you provide a possible explanation?
